csv_project_name: A/E for Ev Charging Station Implementation
csv_scope_of_work: EV Charging Station Implementation. The City of Roseville has issued this Request for Proposal RFP for an Electric Vehicle EV Charging Program. The purpose of this RFP is to solicit Proposals from qualified entities to design, build, operate, and maintain Alternating Current AC Level II Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment Stations and Direct Current Fast Charging DCFC Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment Stations at selected locations within Roseville.

title: A/E for EV Charging Station Implementation
short_description: Design-build-operate-maintain EV charging stations at selected sites in Roseville, California.
project_location: Roseville, Placer County, Northern California, USA
project_scope: Implementation of an electric vehicle charging program at selected locations within Roseville, including AC Level II EV charging stations and DC fast charging stations. The tender covers site selection/evaluation and full delivery of the charging infrastructure program.
services: Design, build, operate, and maintain EV charging stations; civil engineering; site evaluation/selection; planning/master planning; electrical engineering; energy engineering; transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Project is primarily EV charging infrastructure, electrical/energy, and site planning, not a structural engineering project.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building scope is indicated.
- Disciplines focus on civil, electrical, energy, and transportation planning rather than structural design.
- Tender has been canceled and may be re-advertised, reducing immediate relevance.
- Does not fit sbp core target types and is closer to infrastructure program delivery than demanding structural design.

fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The notice is an advance notice for a design-build-operate-maintain EV charging program and does not provide a planning fee, budget, or fee basis.
references_qualifications: Qualified entities for design, build, operate, and maintain EV charging infrastructure; requested disciplines include civil engineering, site evaluation/selection, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, energy engineering, and transportation planning.
